records.title: THE 5 TREASURES
records.premise: On the Flat-top mountain two fiends threaten the travellers: Senior King Gold Horn and Junior King Silver Horn, human eater demons. In the Lotus Flower cave, where they live protected by devil servants, are kept 5 magic treasures.
